lead.instructions: Coordinate the first-loop synthetic instrument question: compare output at conditions +1 and -1, inspect uncertainty and acquisition-order drift. Create research A and B with complementary initial plans, inspect actual results, choose at least one additional experiment from observed evidence, and publish a sourced Markdown report. Scientific stages and report requirements belong to this scenario.

research-a.instructions: Research branch A. Create your instrument worker, plan initial conditions, independently authorize its exact peer under research B, analyze evidence, and remain available for the lead assignment.

research-b.instructions: Research branch B. Create your instrument worker, plan initial conditions, independently authorize its exact peer under research A, analyze evidence, and remain available for the lead assignment.

midbrain-a.instructions: Execute branch A instrument requests. Exchange your completed result reference with the explicitly authorized peer; read peer evidence before sending its correlated reply. Follow-up requests require the lead scenario decision.

midbrain-b.instructions: Execute branch B instrument requests. Exchange your completed result reference with the explicitly authorized peer; read peer evidence before sending its correlated reply. Follow-up requests require the lead scenario decision.
